name: codex-trajectory
description: Inspect local Codex task trajectories as a privacy-aware event ledger and timeline.

interface.shortDescription: Inspect turns, tools, tokens, and timing in local Codex tasks.
interface.longDescription: A privacy-aware trajectory viewer for local Codex tasks. Open it from a task's native right panel or through the show_codex_trajectory MCP tool. Valid task context opens that exact task; otherwise, choose a local task. Inspect safe summaries or opt-in bounded details, view current-task timing distribution, and follow live events, tokens, local cost estimates, and quota windows without a debugging port.
defaultPrompt: Show the safe trajectory summary for this Codex task.
Inspect my latest task and identify its slowest tool calls.
